provenance: Real de-identified db13 OPD encounters, Jul 2026. Real clinical values; identifiers stripped.
purpose: Discriminating (non-saturated) replacement for the canonical check-gold/1.0. Real messy notes where appropriateness is arguable.

scoring.note: P/N/C form the primary floor. L is scored SEPARATELY as a headroom annex (Order-check cannot see member history today, so L mustFire is expected to MISS note-only).

catalog_binding.bound_by: orchestrator, validated against the live seed (15 Jul 2026)
catalog_binding.finding: Only 3 of 8 P-positive cases map to a catalog rec (all cwus-aafp-002, viral URI). 5 P-positives + 3 C cases are CATALOG GAPS (no matching rec) — the dominant recall ceiling. Near-miss guards bound: cwus-aafp-002 (antibiotic over-flag), cwus-aafp-001 (acute-LBP over-flag), cwus-acc-001 (cardiac-imaging over-flag).

cases.scenario: Cold and sore throat for 2 days. No fever. Generalised weakness. Clinically a viral upper respiratory infection.
proposedActions: Azithromycin 500 mg PO once daily x5 days
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotics for uncomplicated viral URI

cases.scenario: Nauseating feeling and loose stools for 5 days. No fever, no blood in stool, no abdominal pain.
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotics for acute non-dysenteric gastroenteritis
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — no acute-gastroenteritis antibiotic rec in the seed.

cases.scenario: High-grade fever (up to 101F) for 2 days with mild headache and malaise. No localising source documented on history or exam.
cases.clinicalTarget: empiric antibiotics for acute undifferentiated fever without a source
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — no undifferentiated-fever antibiotic rec.

cases.scenario: Throat pain for 3-4 days, occasional fever. Exam: throat congested, no exudate; systemic exam normal. No Centor features documented.
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotics for viral pharyngitis (URI) without strep confirmation
cases.note: Bound to the viral-URI rec; pharyngitis is upper-respiratory. Soft binding — the judge decides applies.

cases.scenario: Acne for a few weeks, few papules. Mild inflammatory acne.
cases.clinicalTarget: systemic antibiotic for mild acne

cases.scenario: Knee pain 3 months, no trauma. Exam: crepitus positive, medial and lateral joint-line tenderness. No weight-bearing X-ray done.
cases.clinicalTarget: MRI for a degenerative knee before weight-bearing X-ray

cases.scenario: Low back pain on and off for 2 years, intermittent tingling. No neurological deficit, no red flags (no cancer, weight loss, fever, trauma, or progressive deficit).
cases.clinicalTarget: imaging for chronic low back pain without red flags
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — seed rec cwus-aafp-001 is ACUTE LBP <6wk only; chronic LBP is uncovered.

cases.scenario: Throat pain, hoarseness, and nasal congestion for 1 week; symptomatic treatment taken, still symptomatic. Voice rest advised. Viral laryngitis.
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotics for viral laryngitis / URI (nasal congestion present)

cases.scenario: Post-operative day 17 after ankle deformity surgery. Wound site: discharge present, foul-smelling. CRP 20.8, ESR 40, Hb 9.6. Culture/sensitivity sent.
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotic appropriate — surgical-site infection

cases.scenario: Mastalgia for 1 week. USG breast: mastitis with abscess; small fibroadenoma.
cases.clinicalTarget: antibiotic appropriate — breast abscess/mastitis

cases.scenario: Moderate inflammatory acne, ongoing, with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
cases.clinicalTarget: oral antibiotic appropriate for moderate acne
cases.note: No acne rec in seed; trivial guard (nothing to over-fire).

cases.scenario: Atypical chest pain. Hypertension. Newly-detected diabetes. ECG: deep T-wave inversions in precordial leads. ECHO: LVH, normal LV function.
cases.clinicalTarget: coronary imaging appropriate — symptomatic with abnormal ECG (not the asymptomatic-low-risk rec)

cases.scenario: Low back ache for 1 month radiating to both lower limbs. Lumbar radiculopathy.
proposedActions: MRI lumbar spine with sacroiliac joints, with contrast
cases.clinicalTarget: imaging appropriate — radiculopathy is the red-flag exception to the acute-LBP rec

cases.scenario: Knee pain 1 week, no trauma. Exam: medial joint-line tenderness; McMurray positive for medial meniscus; Lachman and anterior drawer negative.
cases.clinicalTarget: MRI appropriate — positive provocative test
cases.note: No knee rec in seed; trivial guard.

cases.scenario: Ankle pain 2 months, regular sports activity. Exam: anterior drawer positive, diffuse swelling, multi-ligament tenderness. ROM normal, no neurovascular deficit.
cases.clinicalTarget: MRI reasonable — chronic instability with positive drawer
cases.note: No ankle rec in seed; trivial guard. V-delegated softest N-lock.

cases.scenario: Asymptomatic. Dyslipidemia 2.5 years; was on rosuvastatin, stopped 1 month ago. Non-smoker. Family history: hypertension and diabetes. Exercises regularly. Recent labs: HbA1c 5.8, FBS 88.7, Total cholesterol 260, TG 177, HDL 75.8.
cases.clinicalTarget: CAC for risk refinement is guideline-supported (2018 ACC/AHA) — must not be flagged as low-value cardiac imaging
cases.note: Deliberate 'looks low-value but is appropriate' near-miss against the asymptomatic-cardiac-imaging rec.

cases.scenario: Bilateral calf pain 2 months, no trauma. Venous doppler normal. Vascular surgeon and spine surgeon both reviewed - nil intervention. No neurogenic claudication documented.
cases.clinicalTarget: over-imaging after normal doppler and specialist clearance
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — no whole-spine over-imaging rec.

cases.scenario: On-and-off fever and cold for 7-8 days. CXR: prominent bronchovascular markings (no consolidation). ECHO normal.
cases.clinicalTarget: reserve fluoroquinolone for a non-pneumonia respiratory picture
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — URI rec is <7d viral URI/sinusitis; this is an 8-day LRTI-adjacent picture. V-delegated soft lock.

cases.scenario: Knee pain 1 day after taekwondo, heard a pop. Exam: no effusion; Lachman, anterior drawer, and SLR all negative.
cases.clinicalTarget: premature MRI for acute knee with a negative exam
cases.note: CATALOG GAP — no knee rec. V-delegated soft lock.

cases.scenario: Encounter orders repeat labs. The note itself contains no lab history.
cases.memberHistory: 4 months ago: HbA1c 5.1% (normal); full lipid panel normal (LDL 70, Total chol 159). Non-diabetic.
cases.clinicalTarget: repeat HbA1c in a non-diabetic with a recent normal result
cases.note: Annex; not solvable note-only; CATALOG GAP (no outpatient repeat-lab rec). Same real member as RC-C-01.

cases.scenario: Encounter orders repeat labs. The note itself contains no lab history.
cases.memberHistory: 3.5 months ago: HbA1c 5.7% (prediabetes); serial near-normal lipids over the prior year.
cases.clinicalTarget: HbA1c ordered more often than annual in prediabetes

cases.scenario: Encounter orders repeat labs. The note itself contains no lab history.
cases.memberHistory: 3 months ago: HbA1c 5.2% (normal), serial normal; TSH normal.
cases.clinicalTarget: repeat HbA1c in a non-diabetic with a recent normal result
